The supplied compact map and asked-fact map embed historical labels/provenance; their earlier coverage/semantic conclusions were not treated as authority. No referenced historical report or snapshot was opened.

fixed_key_findings.question: How do Damage, Destroy, Remove and Replace differ for Fear and survival? Can Damage from separate normal Powers combine, does Damage normally hurt Dahan, and does replacement erase prior Damage?
fixed_key_findings.old_fixed_key_answer: Damage normally means to Invaders only, distributed as chosen in target land; can combine within turn, immediately destroying pieces at Damage >= Health. Destroying Town/City produces 1/2 Fear in addition to explicit Fear. Remove/Replace generate none automatically; Replace retains prior Damage and may cause destruction if Damage meets new Health (then destruction Fear applies). Surviving Damage clears at Time Passes. Dahan are harmed by Powers only if explicitly stated.
old_required_facts: Unqualified Power Damage normally hurts Invaders in the target land; it does not normally harm Dahan.
Damage from normal separate Powers can combine during the turn.
Damage reaching Health immediately destroys a piece; survivor Damage clears at Time Passes.
Destroying a Town/City causes 1/2 Fear in addition to explicit Fear.
Remove/Replace themselves generate no destruction Fear.
Replace retains prior Damage and can cause destruction if it meets the new piece's Health.
fixed_key_findings.recommended_correction: Explicitly distinguish direct Destroy and Remove from Damage: a direct Destroy instruction eliminates its specified Invader regardless of its remaining Health or Damage; Remove also takes the specified piece off the board without a Damage/Health test, but does not generate destruction Fear. Replace removes the original and puts the specified replacement in its place, retaining marked Damage, with a new Health check on the replacement. Do not require a second recital of actor or removal details when the answer already states these results unambiguously.
fixed_key_findings.reason: Q18 expressly asks how all four operations differ for survival, as well as Fear. The key/map state the Damage threshold and replacement retention, but the Destroy/Remove clauses cover only Fear. An answer following those listed requirements could omit the asked distinction between damage requiring sufficient Damage and an outright Destroy/Remove bypassing that test. This is an answer-scope omission; none of the existing quoted key facts is false.

CORE p15: some effects destroy Invaders regardless of Damage or Health

preservation: Frozen inputs were not edited. Proposed additions/corrections are report-only. No git mutations.
technical_limitations: The source-only findings use the captured assigned source versions; no live source refresh or outside corpus was used.
The original Spirit panel faces were not supplied as image inputs; Spirit procedures were checked against the complete assigned official FAQ and CORE.
All33 supplied primary faces and both membership-reference images were received at full bounds. The primary faces are300x420 pixels, sufficient to read the printed rules and corner marks.
summary: All154 literal questions and fixed answers were checked. No incorrect existing source assertion or map over-demand survives this pass. Q18 leaves part of its expressly requested survival comparison implicit/absent in the listed requirements; add that comparison before relying on the map as complete.

membership_assessment.authority: Publisher-linked Branch & Claw p6 corner-symbol legend, all full faces/corners and designer core-printing corrections. Catalog set labels were not membership authority.
membership_assessment.conclusion: Both excluded exemplars display the B&C corner emblem; they were not used as original-core producers. The other31 faces have no such emblem and match the original-core assigned corpus/printing corrections.
